images.alt: Vergelijking: het gras verdort — 1 Petrus 1:24; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. 1 Peter 1:24–25 compares human glory to grass and a flower which withers, contrasting the enduring word of the Lord. Photorealistic landscape detail of delicate wildflowers and dry fading grass on a rocky ancient Anatolian hillside, one fallen flower visible beside living stems in soft wind. No human skeleton, death spectacle, readable scripture or modern objects. A restrained botanical metaphor, natural colour and textures, distinct from the existing goldsmith image.

images.alt: Lesbeeld: niet meer meedoen — 1 Petrus 4:4; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. 1 Peter 4:3–4 says former companions find it strange that believers no longer join their drunken excesses and speak ill of them. Dignified illustrative first-century courtyard scene, one plainly clothed adult believer calmly leaving a rowdy drinking gathering while two fully clothed adult former companions beside a table of clay wine cups look after him with mocking expressions. No sexual content, visible intoxication injuries or violence, no invented famous martyr. Three adults only, calm resolve in the foreground, coherent hands and feet. Illustrates the described social pressure, not a named recorded event.

Photorealistic healthy adult male lion alone prowling an ancient dry rocky wilderness, mouth open in a natural roar, four correct legs with paws visibly placed, powerful but no prey, victim, blood, attack, horns, wings or literal devil figure. Landscape 3:2 natural dusk light. A clear animal comparison, not a historical lion attack on the church.
